content:
A leaker with a mixed track record has shared a video that appears to show two new color options for the iPhone 18 Pro on display in a retail store.

The short clip shows what we were expecting in terms of a deep cherry red and a blue, but is almost certainly a fake…

The 14-second video shows someone holding a cherry red iPhone 18 Pro Max, with a deep blue iPhone 17 Pro Max next to it for comparison. We also see a light blue model on a display stand.

The environment looks like a retail store. Macworld thinks it could be real.

I'm more skeptical, however.

My colleague Fernando Silva was at the IFA trade show recently, and he says that every company had dummy units that looked and felt real, so getting hold of one of these models would be trivially easy. Additionally, the store environment itself gives me pause. The display table is too small for a store, the product labels seem to float freely and are angled haphazardly, and there is no real store background to be seen.

Finally, while the leaker has some past credibility, they have recently just been collating posts from Chinese social media.
